notes: Village of Riverwoods zoning layer (GHA Engineers MapServer/1, ZONECLASS). Ordinance = Village Code Title 9 Zoning §9-3-1 (amlegal riverwoodsil, current through Ord. 26-01-01 passed 1-20-2026; fetched 2026-10-14). SS = 'SS Automobile service stations district' (§9-3-1, Art. 9B) -- NOT self-storage. 1-R is a real district ('1-R 42,000 square feet (inclusive of road easements) single-family residential district', Art. 4A). 'R-4 CC' -> R-4 (Golf course and country club residential district; CC = country club). 'O & R1' -> O&R1 (O and R1 office and research district one); 'O & RC' -> O&R/C (O and R/C office and research compatible district). 'R-1 PUD' (1 polygon) -> R-1 (residential PUD is an R-1 special use, §9-11-12). Layer SPECIAL=YES attribute marks special-use parcels, not a district. SL listed in §9-3-1 but its article was replaced by the PD overlay (Ord. 25-02-02); not on layer.
